vehicles.name: Dzo Hatch
vehicles.blurb: The starting vehicle: a small hatchback that is light on fuel but struggles on steep hills and in mud.

vehicles.name: Tourist Coaster
vehicles.blurb: A ten-seat minibus. It is heavy and leans in corners, so brake early and take bends smoothly.

vehicles.name: Druk Ranger
vehicles.blurb: A five-seat SUV with selectable 4x2 and 4x4. Quick, with good grip on hairpins and muddy hills.

vehicles.name: Dragon Cruiser
vehicles.blurb: The most capable vehicle: a six-seat 4x4 with strong torque and the best off-road and river-crossing ability.

routes.name: Pass Run
routes.subtitle: Village to the prayer-flag pass
routes.summary: Your first tourism run. Pick up a family and a hiker, swap guests at the viewpoint and climb to the summit plaza, with a fuel stop and a workshop on the way.

routes.name: Thimphu Town Pickup
routes.subtitle: City streets to Buddha Dordenma
routes.summary: A morning of pickups around Thimphu: busy streets, then the climb to the Buddha Dordenma viewpoint.

routes.name: Airport Dash
routes.subtitle: Thimphu to the departure gate
routes.summary: A tour group is late for their flight. Collect them at the hotel and drive the Thimphu to Paro highway. A smooth ride keeps passengers happy.

routes.name: Punakha Valley Tour
routes.subtitle: Two rivers and a dzong
routes.summary: Rice terraces, villages, the river road and the dzong where two rivers meet. Expect rain, mud, a narrow bridge, a ford and farm traffic.

routes.name: Dochula Storm Descent
routes.subtitle: Down the pass before the storm peaks
routes.summary: Get your guests down from Dochula before a storm closes in. Fog, heavy rain, slippery hairpins and a landslide below.

routes.name: Trongsa Gorge Run
routes.subtitle: The road with the drop
routes.summary: A narrow, patched mountain road to Trongsa: a cliff ledge, a one-lane bridge, falling rocks and a muddy climb. Watch your brakes.

routes.name: Chelela Hill Climb
routes.subtitle: Up to the snow and the high pass
routes.summary: Fourteen hairpins from the Paro foothills to the snowy Chele La viewpoint. Frost, packed snow and ice, with deeper snow for four-wheel drive.

routes.name: Bumthang Night Expedition
routes.subtitle: Forest roads after dark
routes.summary: A long forest road after dark, with fog, unlit bridges and animals in your headlights. Your lamps only reach about forty metres.

routes.name: Eastern Tshechu Expedition
routes.subtitle: Mud, rocks and rivers
routes.summary: Take a documentary team and their gear to a remote camp over mud tracks, a broken highway and rockfalls, with the rains arriving early.

routes.name: GMC Plains Challenge
routes.subtitle: The long road to Gelephu
routes.summary: The final assignment: guests from a southern mountain lodge to Gelephu Mindfulness City, over a long descent, landslides, mud, river crossings, a monsoon storm and a busy town. Check passengers’ ID.
